caption: The drawing depicts a single slate top table rendered in perspective view using black and gray ink, with red guidelines indicating the perspective grid. The table has a rectangular slate top, a drawer in the front adorned with two decorative gilt pulls and a central escutcheon plate, and four turned, baluster-shaped legs. Each leg terminates in a bun foot, and the legs are connected at the bottom by arched stretchers converging at a central finial. The body of the table features a scalloped apron on all four sides. The left side of the drawing includes a small geometric diagram and handwritten measurements indicating a horizon line at "42'' high" and a "Line of Distance—72''." On the right is a handwritten label reading "Perspective Drawing of Slate Top Table," with accession number, room and scale information, and the artist's signature ("M. Rosenfield-Wattolini"). The entire composition is drawn on lightly aged beige paper.
title: Slate-top Table
